vacancy_details.details: The recruitment is conducted for 1 NCA vacancy for the Telephone Operator post earmarked for Scheduled Castes in the State of Kerala. This is the second NCA notification for the vacancy that arose from Ranked List No. REC 3-1796/2024 dated 24.10.2025 (Rec. No. 18/2024). The ranked list prepared under this notification will remain in force until a candidate is advised and appointed against the vacancy earmarked for Scheduled Castes.

how_to_apply: Access the Recruitment Portal of the High Court at https://hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in.

Complete "One Time Registration" using the "One Time Registration Login" link and review the "How to apply" guidelines. Keep scanned images of your passport size photograph (white/light-colored background with face and shoulder clearly visible) and signature ready.
Log into your profile and select the "My Profile" option in the dashboard to enter the required details.

Select the "Upload documents" option in the dashboard and upload properly scanned and legible copies of your Plus Two or equivalent certificate, Diploma in Electronics, experience certificate, and any other relevant documents.
Select the 'Apply Now' option in the dashboard, review the preview of your application carefully, and submit it before the closure date.
Keep a soft or hard copy of the submitted application for future reference. Do not send printouts or documents to the High Court.
important_instructions: Only candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes in the State of Kerala are eligible to apply. Applications from other communities are summarily rejected. Caste certificates valid on the date fixed for closure of filing of online applications or certificate verification must be produced in the format appended to G.O. (P) No. 11/2026/SCSTD dated 14.03.2026. Government employees must indicate their service in the application and produce a No Objection Certificate/Service Certificate when called for. Canvassing in any form will entail immediate cancellation of candidature. Candidates must download Admission Tickets/Call Letters from their profile; hard copies are not sent by post.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted for 1 NCA vacancy for the Telephone Operator post earmarked for Scheduled Castes in the State of Kerala. This is the second NCA notification for the vacancy that arose from Ranked List No. REC 3-1796/2024 dated 24.10.2025 (Rec. No. 18/2024). The ranked list prepared under this notification will remain in force until a candidate is advised and appointed against the vacancy earmarked for Scheduled Castes.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the following essential qualifications and eligibility criteria: Nationality & Community: Indian citizens belonging to the Scheduled Castes in the State of Kerala alone are eligible to apply. Applications from other communities will be summarily rejected. Educational Qualification: Plus Two or equivalent, and a Diploma in Electronics awarded by an Institution recognized by the Government. Experience: Six months experience as Telephone Operator/Receptionist and in Computer Operation. The experience certificate must be in the required format available in the 'Downloads' link in the recruitment portal. Language Proficiency: Fluency in English, Malayalam and Hindi. Age Limit: Candidates must have been born between 02/01/1981 and 01/01/2008 (both days inclusive).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kerala High Court Telephone Operator
content_sections.text: Access the Recruitment Portal of the High Court at https://hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in . Complete "One Time Registration" using the "One Time Registration Login" link and review the "How to apply" guidelines. Keep scanned images of your passport size photograph (white/light-colored background with face and shoulder clearly visible) and signature ready. Log into your profile and select the "My Profile" option in the dashboard to enter the required details. Select the "Upload documents" option in the dashboard and upload properly scanned and legible copies of your Plus Two or equivalent certificate, Diploma in Electronics, experience certificate, and any other relevant documents. Select the 'Apply Now' option in the dashboard, review the preview of your application carefully, and submit it before the closure date. Keep a soft or hard copy of the submitted application for future reference. Do not send printouts or documents to the High Court.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on Interview or Written Test & Interview depending on the number of candidates. If conducted, the Written Test will be of Objective Type with a duration of 75 minutes, comprising 100 questions carrying 1 mark each. A negative marking of 1/4 mark applies for every incorrect answer. Total marks for the Interview shall be 10, and candidates must secure a minimum of 35% marks in the Interview to be considered for inclusion in the ranked list.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under notification 7/2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available, designated as an NCA vacancy for Scheduled Castes in the State of Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for closure of filing of online applications is 16/11/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is charged for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Plus Two or equivalent certificate, a Diploma in Electronics recognized by the Government, six months experience as a Telephone Operator/Receptionist and in Computer Operation, and fluency in English, Malayalam and Hindi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must have been born between 02/01/1981 and 01/01/2008 (both days inclusive), subject to applicable relaxations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for the Telephone Operator post?
faq.answer: The post carries a scale of pay of ₹ 31100-66800.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an Interview or a Written Test and Interview, with total interview marks set at 10 and a minimum qualifying mark of 35% in the interview.
